$comment: The UI boundary (ADR-APP-026). Project-owned: every project has different dependencies, so this file is never pinned and never delivered by governance:update. EVERY runtime dependency must appear in exactly one list, or `npm run lint` fails — that is what makes the rule a gate instead of a reminder.

notes.@fontsource/inter: A font: CSS + woff2. Puts no control on screen.
notes.@tauri-apps/api: The IPC boundary to the Rust backend. Renders nothing.
notes.lucide-react: Icon glyphs — SVG paths, no chrome, no behaviour, and they inherit the HUD's colour. An icon is not a control; the control around it is a HUD primitive.
notes.@xterm/xterm: The terminal emulator (ADR-PROJ-001 §1). It draws a character grid whose entire appearance — palette, font, cursor, selection — comes from our theme, so it is a MECHANISM, not a control wearing its own look (ADR-APP-026). What must stay HUD is the chrome around it: the tab strip, the context menu, the scrollbar, the search UI. src/components/ui/TerminalSurface.tsx is the only file allowed to import it.
notes.@xterm/addon-fit: Measures cell-accurate rows/cols on resize — the input to terminal_resize. Renders nothing of its own.
notes.@xterm/addon-webgl: The renderer that keeps a flood of output at frame rate. Falls back to xterm's built-in DOM renderer when WebGL is unavailable.
notes.@xterm/addon-unicode11: Correct East-Asian and emoji cell widths. Without it, 'full feature set' would not be true.
notes.@xterm/addon-web-links: Detects URLs in the output. Opening goes through the existing open_external command, never the webview.
notes._no_addon_canvas: @xterm/addon-canvas is deliberately absent: 0.7.0 declares peer @xterm/xterm@^5, so it does not support xterm 6. It was never load-bearing — xterm's built-in DOM renderer is the fallback when WebGL is unavailable, and addon-canvas is a third option, not the safety net (ADR-PROJ-001 §1).
notes._no_addon_search: @xterm/addon-search is not installed yet: it finds and highlights, but the search bar is ours to build, and a dependency with no caller fails the unused-dependency check (rule:dependencies). It arrives with its UI.
